definitions.gloss: breastfeeding; nursing; feeding a baby milk
definitions.explanation: The act of feeding an infant milk, typically from the breast. Also used more broadly for bottle-feeding in some contexts.

examples.japanese: {授乳|じゅにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{授乳室|じゅにゅうしつ}→授乳室：07065_junyuushitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This facility has a nursing room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}→授乳中：29228_junyuuchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。

notes:
A standard term used in medical, parenting, and public facility contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{授乳室|じゅにゅうしつ}→授乳室：07065_junyuushitsu⟧ (nursing room)
- {授乳|じゅにゅう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ / ⟦{授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}→授乳中：29228_junyuuchuu⟧ (breastfeeding period)
- {授乳|じゅにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to breastfeed)

USAGE:
⟦{授乳室|じゅにゅうしつ}→授乳室：07065_junyuushitsu⟧ signs are common in department stores, train stations, and public buildings throughout Japan. While the word literally involves breast milk (⟦{乳|にゅう}→乳：28296_nyuu⟧), {授乳|じゅにゅう} is used broadly to cover feeding babies in general, including bottle-feeding.
